spearheads.name: Blades of the Lurid Dream
spearheads.text:
Slaanesh, the loathsome yet beguiling Dark Prince of the Ruinous Powers, excels in ensnaring mortals. He whispers that they might slake their most salacious desires, if only they should enter into his service. For many who endure existences of privation and drudgery, it is an offer too tempting to resist. Reality becomes a phantasmagoric paradise of revelry to these Sybarites, every torment theirs to inflict and have inflicted upon them. Many form warbands who seek to inhabit this blissful dream-state for eternity – and drag more noble souls down into the depths of their depravity.
It is the Shardspeakers who direct these packs of murderous libertines and who channel the power of the Dark Prince like a powerful intoxicant. Through clouds of incense dart Blissbarb Archers, whose arrows are smeared with poisons that distort the senses. Only then do the elite of the Sybarites move in for the kill. Disdainful laughter echoes as Slickblade Seekers sprint forwards to slice off heads, herding surviving prey towards their doom. That doom is delivered by the Slaangor Fiendbloods. The arrival of these trilling beast-kin is the breaking point for the foe; some weep in terror, some cry out in joy and try desperately to embrace them. All are ripped asunder, their dream turning to a gruesome nightmare in their agonised final moments.

battle_traits.name: TEMPTATIONS OF SLAANESH
battle_traits.effect:
You receive 6 temptation dice at the start of the battle round. Each time your opponent makes a failed hit roll, a failed wound roll or a failed save roll, you can offer them a temptation dice. If they accept your offer, that roll is replaced with a 6. Rolls replaced in this way cannot be re-rolled or modified.
Each time your opponent accepts your offer of a temptation dice, you gain D6 depravity points. Each time your opponent rejects your offer of a temptation dice, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit for which the roll was made.
You cannot offer your opponent a temptation dice for the same enemy unit more than once per phase. At the end of the battle round, all remaining temptation dice are lost.
All friendly units gain passive abilities from the table below based on the number of depravity points you have. These abilities are cumulative.

options.name: 12+: Tantalising Torment
options.text: This unit can use a RUN ability and still use CHARGE abilities later in the turn

options.name: 18+: Sadistic Spite
options.text: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

regiment_abilities.name: UNPARALLELED SPEED
regiment_abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
regiment_abilities.effect: That unit has STRIKE-FIRST this phase.

regiment_abilities.name: LOCUS OF DIVERSION
regiment_abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
regiment_abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, that unit can use a RETREAT ability and still use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities later in the turn.

enhancements.name: SCEPTRE OF DOMINATION
enhancements.declare: Roll a dice for each enemy unit in combat with your general.
enhancements.effect: On a 5+, the unit being rolled for has STRIKE-LAST this phase.

enhancements.name: CACOPHONIC CHOIR
enhancements.effect: On a 6+, make a cacophony roll of D6. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit (roll for each) within 6" of your general that has a Control characteristic less than the cacophony roll.

enhancements.name: TWISTED MIRROR
enhancements.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of your general and roll a dice.
enhancements.effect: On a 4+, subtract 1 from save rolls for that unit until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: VISION OF DAMNATION
abilities.effect: On a 6+, roll 6 dice. For each 4+, you receive 1 depravity point.

abilities.name: UNRIVALLED VELOCITY
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.

warscrolls.name: Slaangor Fiendbloods

abilities.name: SLAUGHTER AT ANY COST
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability if any damage points were allocated to it this turn.
abilities.effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscrolls.composition: This unit has 2 Slaangor Fiendbloods armed with Razorsharp Claws, and 1 Slaangor Fiendblood armed with a Razor-sharp Claw and Gilded Weapon.

warscrolls.name: Blissbarb Archers

abilities.name: LIGHT-FOOTED KILLERS
abilities.effect: This unit can use SHOOT abilities even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.

warscrolls.composition: One unit has 5 Blissbarb Archers and 1 Blissbrew Homonculus. The other unit has 5 Blissbarb Archers. The Blissbarb Archers are each armed with a Blissbarb Bow and Sybarite Blade. The Blissbrew Homonculus is armed with a Sybarite Blade.

spearheads.name: Epicurean Revellers
spearheads.text:
Slaanesh’s daemons must typically be summoned to the Mortal Realms through painstaking (and inevitably painful) rites of invoking. Yet sometimes, the acts of atrocity and vice carried out by a marauding horde or ascendant cult will reach such a delectable climax that warhosts of the Dark Prince’s own children can tear the veil of their own accord. These Epicurean Revellers rarely have any grand strategy in mind; their only urge is to slake those desires that only conventional reality may facilitate, engaging in orgies of blood and slaughter before returning to Slaanesh’s realm.
Greater daemons of Slaanesh rarely lower themselves to lead such warbands; rather, it is discordant courtiers from the Palace of Pleasure who seize these opportunities, eager to prove the worth of their own dark fascinations to one another. They bring with them not only Daemonette handmaidens but also the stranger daemonic beasts of Slaanesh’s domain – hooting, warbling entities whose senses are inflamed by the stench of mortal souls…

battle_traits.name: FAVOUR MOST FICKLE
battle_traits.effect: The following effects apply based on the number of friendly units on the battlefield. These effects are not cumulative:

options.name: • 5 or more units
options.text: Add 2 to the Control characteristic of friendly units.

options.name: • 4 units
options.text: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks, including attacks made with Companion weapons.

options.name: • 3 units
options.text: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units.

options.name: • 1 unit
options.text: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly units’ melee weapons, including Companion weapons.

regiment_abilities.name: BRINGERS OF DEGRADATION
regiment_abilities.effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a FIGHT ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick 2 friendly Daemonettes units instead of 1 unit. Resolve the second FIGHT ability immediately after the first.

regiment_abilities.name: DAEMONIC ONSLAUGHT
regiment_abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Seekers or Fiends unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
regiment_abilities.effect: The target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

enhancements.name: TWISTED GRACE
enhancements.effect: When your general makes a pile-in move, if they charged in the same turn, add D6" to the distance they can move.

enhancements.name: EXCESS OF VIOLENCE
enhancements.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
enhancements.effect: The target’s melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits) until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: HIGH COURTIERS
enhancements.effect: While your general is wholly within the combat range of a friendly Daemonettes unit, both units have WARD (5+).

enhancements.name: IRRESISTIBLE SOUL-MUSK
enhancements.declare: Pick a visible friendly Seekers or Fiends unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
enhancements.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: THRICEFOLD COURT
abilities.effect: Each model in this unit is treated as an individual unit when determining the effect of the ‘Favour Most Fickle’ battle trait.

abilities.name: DISPENSERS OF FAVOUR
abilities.declare: Pick up to X different friendly units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets, where X is the number of models in this unit. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
On a 6+, apply the relevant effect to each target:
Daemonettes: The target’s weapons have Anti‑charge (+1 Rend) until the start of your next turn. Seekers: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. Fiends: Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: SOPORIFIC MUSK
abilities.declare:
If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 9" of it to be the target.
If this unit is in combat, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: LITHE AND SWIFT
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Piercing Claws if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: QUICKSILVER SPEED
abilities.effect: When making run rolls for this unit, if you roll a 1-3, you can use a value of 4 instead.
